text:
Avery (People Ops): Heads up — launching a 6‑month pilot for Family Care Top‑Up starting Jul 1. This provides up to 6 weeks of 100% pay while on approved short-term family care leave (runs alongside statutory leave). Details below.
Samir: Nice — who’s eligible? Full-time only?
Avery (People Ops): Eligibility: all benefits-eligible employees (FT & PT pro-rated after 6 months service). Contractors & temps not eligible for pilot.
Jules: Can this be used for eldercare or only newborn/adoption?
Avery (People Ops): Covers newborn, adoption, fostering, and immediate family serious medical care (incl. eldercare). We’ll require medical/placement documentation as per usual leave process.
HR Bot: Policy doc uploaded: https://redwoodhr.internal/policies/family-care-topup (see FAQ, request form link)
Laila: International teams — will local statutory differences apply? e.g., UK/DE employees already have different leave rules.
Avery (People Ops): Yes — the pilot is additive where local law allows. For locations with stronger statutory pay, we’ll top-up to match company policy where permitted. People Ops will follow up individually for non-US locations.
Maya: How does this interact with PTO bank? Do I need to burn PTO first?
Avery (People Ops): No — Top‑Up is paid separately and does not force PTO usage. You can choose to use PTO concurrently to extend income beyond the top-up period. See examples in the doc.
Samir: Are retroactive claims allowed for leaves that started last month?
Avery (People Ops): No retroactive payments. Pilot effective date Jul 1. If you had approved leave after Jul 1 and didn’t claim, open a ticket.
Avery (People Ops): To request — submit leave in Workday, attach docs, select 'Family Care Top-Up' option. People Ops will review within 5 business days.
Avery (People Ops): Quick note: this is a pilot — we’ll measure utilization, satisfaction, and budget impact. Feedback welcome: #people-ops or DM me. :heart:
Maya: Thanks! Very helpful.
HR Bot: Reminder sent to eligible employees: "Family Care Top-Up pilot — enroll by Sep 30".
